episodes.synopsis: Two years after the world as we know it has ended, Shizuru leads an uneventful life in her hometown of Agano. But one day, she finds a clue that will lead her on a journey into the unknown to find her missing friend.
episodes.title: I'll Be Going Now

episodes.synopsis: Shizuru and the others depart on their journey to Ikebukuro, but find that they are woefully lacking in supplies. As they ride along the Koma River, they spot a mysterious, long-necked shadow.
episodes.title: Suppose, Maybe, Presumably

episodes.synopsis: The gang finds themselves welcomed by the friendly townsfolk of Higashi-Agano. Akira, however, can't shake the feeling that all is not as it seems with their generous hosts.
episodes.title: Short, Happy, and Easy

episodes.synopsis: As the train continues on its journey to Ikebukuro, each new stop begins to take weirder, wilder turns. Meanwhile, Akira appears to be hiding something from the others.
episodes.title: Why Are You Hiding Your Butt?

episodes.synopsis: Shizuru and Reimi find themselves prisoners near Inariyama Park. They must escape their tiny captors, and find a doctor to cure Akira's affliction before it's too late.
episodes.title: I'll Be Reduced to Bones

episodes.synopsis: Pochi-san appears to be feeling sick, much to Akira's dismay. In the ensuing argument, Nadeshiko confronts Shizuru to find out the truth about why Yoka has gone missing.
episodes.title: Was What I Said That Awful?

episodes.synopsis: Shizuru is taken captive, and Nadeko and the others must infiltrate a horde of zombies to rescue her. However, they'll first need to hoodwink the queen of the zombies.
episodes.title: A Zombie That Laughs Is No Zombie at All

episodes.synopsis: Reimi is excited to head into Oizumi-gakuen, which has transformed into her favorite anime. However, they're met with a much bleaker retelling where the bad guys reign supreme.
episodes.title: Isn't That Bad Karma?

episodes.synopsis: Yoka wakes up to find herself in Ikebukuro, now transformed beyond recognition. Elsewhere, Shizuru and the others, still on their journey, run into a familiar face.
episodes.title: More Boring Than I Thought

episodes.synopsis: Shizuru spots a mysterious silhouette on the train tracks near Higashi-Nagasaki, belonging to a mysterious creature who happens to remind her of someone.
episodes.title: A True Symbol of Rebellion and Decadence

episodes.synopsis: The train finally reaches its last stop, Ikebukuro. Now it's up to Shizuru and the others to find Yoka and put an end to the 7G menace.
episodes.title: Maybe She's a Lost Cause...

episodes.synopsis: Poison Pontaro sets off on an armored train with Yoka in tow. The fate of the world now rides on Shizuru and the gang, in hot pursuit aboard the Apogee.
episodes.title: What Was Normal Again?
